name: lodge
description: Local-first delivery workbench for multi-agent rooms, evidence and handoff.
author: Lodge

scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run prepare:base && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run prepare:base && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.check:done: npm test && npm run check:unused && npm run check:deps && npm run check:skills && npm run check:prompts && npm run test:ui && npm run smoke:electron && npm run check:docs && npm run check:acceptance && npm run check:regressions && npm run check:sandbox && npm run eval:rooms -- --validate && npm run eval:long-task && npm run eval:history-bench
scripts.check:ci: npm test && npm run check:unused && npm run check:deps && npm run check:skills && npm run check:prompts && npm run test:ui && npm run check:docs && npm run check:acceptance && npm run check:regressions && npm run check:sandbox && npm run eval:rooms -- --validate && npm run eval:long-task && npm run eval:history-bench
scripts.base:rs:test: npm run base:rs:build && node base-rs/contract.test.mjs && node base-rs/persistence.test.mjs && node base-rs/pi-driver.test.mjs && node base-rs/claude-driver.test.mjs && node base-rs/codex-driver.test.mjs && node base-rs/sandbox-run.test.mjs && node base-rs/windows-sandbox.test.mjs && node base-rs/orphan.test.mjs && node base-rs/errors.test.mjs && node base-rs/conformance.test.mjs && node base-rs/behavior.test.mjs && node base-rs/self-check.test.mjs && node base-rs/settings-effect.test.mjs && node base-rs/pi-extension.test.mjs && node base-rs/extension-guard.test.mjs && node base-rs/kill-matrix.test.mjs && node base-rs/retry.test.mjs && node base-rs/mcp-gate.test.mjs
scripts.check:sandbox: npm run base:rs:build && node base-rs/sandbox-bench.test.mjs && node base-rs/windows-sandbox.test.mjs
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test e2e/visual.spec.mjs
scripts.test:budget: npm run build && playwright test e2e/budget.spec.mjs
